title: The Less the Merrier? Investigating Language Representation in Multilingual Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the disparity in language inclusion (high-resource vs. low-resource), visualizing and clustering embedding spaces (using UMAP and K-Means) to see how models represent different language families, dialects, and writing scripts, and evaluating downstream task performance via Named Entity Recognition (NER) accuracy and language-adherence in text generation.
